title: Sam Altman

Sam Altman

# Sam Altman

CEO of OpenAI

Sam Altman is CEO of OpenAI. He co-founded the artificial intelligence startup, originally created as a nonprofit research lab, in 2015. Altman has led OpenAI's commercialization of products in recent years, most notably its viral ChatGPT chatbot, as well as its restructuring into a for-profit company.

OpenAI lost its No. 2 on 9 July 2026. Fidji Simo, who had run ChatGPT and OpenAI's other apps since 2025, stepped down to a part-time advisory role after a long medical leave, TechCrunch reported. Product strategy now sits with OpenAI's president, Greg Brockman.

...

## Who runs OpenAI now?

Sam Altman runs OpenAI, as its CEO. He's held the job since March 2019, when OpenAI's own post first listed him as CEO, except for a few days in November 2023. On 17 November that year the board said he "was not consistently candid in his communications with the board" and named Mira Murati interim CEO. It didn't last. He was back within the week, and OpenAI's return post opens with his line: "I am returning to OpenAI as CEO." Murati went back to being CTO.

Before he ran OpenAI, Altman ran Y Combinator. Paul Graham named him its president on 21 February 2014. In an interview with Vanity Fair, reported by Yahoo Finance on 5 October 2026, he said of a future stock listing: "if they're ever in tension, the mission is going to come first."

Altman doesn't run ChatGPT on his own. Fortune reported on 22 June 2026 that product strategy sits with Brockman "with Sottiaux leading core product and platform." Thibault Sottiaux is the man who used to run Codex. OpenAI says over 1.2 billion people use ChatGPT each week (7 October 2026).

...

Altman was back as CEO within the week, with a new initial board chaired by Bret Taylor. Murati returned to her CTO role, OpenAI said.

## Takeaways by Bloomberg AI

Apple Inc. Executive Chairman Tim Cook, OpenAI Chief Executive Officer Sam Altman and Qualcomm Inc. head Cristiano Amon are poised to attend a White House state dinner for Chinese President Xi Jinping next week.
